Five ordered migrations have matching rollback and verification SQL but have not been applied.

The Rust companion compiles, links and passes all-target tests on Windows, including a packaged sidecar round trip. Its current frontend is a minimal overlay rather than the authenticated OCADE application, so an installed desktop application route and signed installer still require release integration and publisher credentials.

scripts/browser-cdp-parity.mjs passed against installed Chrome and Edge through the extensionless Playwright/CDP host, including protected-field refusal, independently observed DOM mutation, upload, download, tabs, immediate cancellation and emergency stop. The self-contained Windows sidecar passed its self-test, and the Rust supervisor launched both real browsers through that packaged executable before closing both through emergency stop. This proves the bounded Windows host path, not standalone-web connectivity, release signing or cross-platform installers.

src/lib/packaging/update-plan.ts decides apply/skip/refuse and rollback targets with fail-closed provenance and downgrade guards (33 unit tests); the runtime half — download, Ed25519 signature verification, binary swap and relaunch — lives in the Tauri updater plugin and can only be proven on a real installed machine.

src/lib/providers/free-tool-adapters.ts detects Blender, FreeCAD and CalculiX and gates capabilities on a real version banner, earning installed_application only when the binary identifies itself; none of the three is installed here, so every capability correctly resolves to deterministic_fixture. Detection is runtime-verified against this machine; invoking a render, CAD rebuild or FEA solve requires the tools to be installed.
